notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting6': Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) ('H 1st Marker'), Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) ('H 4th Marker'), Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice ('DODN/WA'), Strike Planning and Squadron Assignments; they count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

The post (30 March 2001) is a pre-release 'Post Tatooine' list; the author says he does not have the new cards yet. Tatooine-set cards: Qui-Gon Jinn, Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber, You'll Find I'm Full Of Surprises.

Posted 'Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (conjecture that there will be a Qui-Gon's Stick)' dested the Tatooine Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (the author was guessing such a card would exist). 'Gui-Gon Jinn' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine).

Posted 'H EDB x3' dested Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (a unique site, posted three times; kept as published). 'H E Corridor' Hoth: Echo Corridor; 'H E Command Center' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Hoth' and 'Endor' the Light system printings.

Posted 'G.S. 1' and 'G.S. 3' dested Green Squadron 1 and Green Squadron 3 (there is no Gold Squadron 3); 'R.S. 1' Red Squadron 1; 'WARSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'O&B Lars' Owen Lars & Beru Lars; 'EPP Luke/Obi/Leia/Han' the Jedi Pack/Premium EPP characters; 'Gen. Crix' General Crix Madine.

Posted 'ITTL' (under the header 'Admiral's Order's1') dested the Admiral's Order I'll Take The Leader. The headers and the comment '(check out this card on Decipher)' after You'll Find I'm Full Of Surprises are not cards.
